build_teacher_model: build a teacher model from a torchscript file or config using _build_teacher with a CfgNode
apply_distillation_hook: apply the DistillationModelingHook to a student model to enable knowledge distillation during training
record_layer_outputs: record intermediate layer outputs from a model using record_layers to cache activations for distillation loss computation
compute_layer_losses: compute layer-wise distillation losses between student and teacher cached outputs using compute_layer_losses with LayerLossMetadata
use_knowledge_distillation_mixin: apply the KnowledgeDistillation dynamic mixin to a model to enable training with teacher layer loss supervision
